title: Ramp Energy — GPE to KE (frictionless incline)
description: Ramp + seatOn living exhibit (SO-A), mirrored (high side right). The ball starts at rest seated near the crest of a frictionless 35° incline: mgh becomes ½mv², so the foot speed is v = √(2gΔh) ≈ 5.9 m/s — the speed graph rises along a concave arc and plateaus there as the ball coasts along the frictionless floor. E = mgy + ½mv² stays constant frame by frame. The ball authors only x — drag it up or down the ramp to change the release height and the prediction with it.
